card.name: Partway through long medical words
card.fires_on: Responds to the middle piece of a longer medical word, such as 'en' before 'cephalopathy', 'ically' after 'Clin', or 'den' before 'osumab'. It appears in drug-label warnings and interaction sections.

modes.label: en- inside words
modes.description: The piece 'en' that starts a word like encephalopathy or engraftment.
modes.example: hyperammonemia with and without<< en>>cephalopathy [see Contraindic

modes.label: Clin-ically
modes.description: The ending 'ically' after 'Clin' at the start of 'clinically significant'.
modes.example: WARNING: HEPATOTOXICITY and EMBRYOFETAL TOXICITY • Hepatotoxicity: Clin<<ically>> significant and potentially life-threatening liver injury,

modes.label: Drug name start
modes.description: The piece 'den' inside the drug name denosumab.
modes.example: severe hypocalcemia following<< den>>osumab products administration.
